fields.summary_ko.0: KB Securities maintained a target price of KRW 600,000 for Samsung Electronics (005930) with a 'Buy' rating, forecasting 2026–2027 operating profit of KRW 1,022 trillion, exceeding the company's cumulative 56-year operating profit.
fields.summary_ko.1: Samsung Electronics' global HBM market share rose from 21% in Q1 this year to 40% in Q3, and next year's average HBM selling price is projected to increase 150% year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.2: Samsung Electronics' operating profit next year is expected to rank first globally, surpassing Nvidia, marking a historic turning point for corporate valuation reassessment.
